positions.title: Head Undergraduate Teaching Assistant, Computer Architecture
positions.description:
- Promoted to head UTA position after less than one semester based on performance and highest student feedback
- Perform all normal UTA duties
- Create homework testing kits and recitation materials
- Coordinate staff meetings and grading 
- Work directly with professor to ensure all aspects of the course run smoothly
- Manage team of 20+ UTAs per semester and coordinate between professor, UTAs, and GTAs

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- CS/ECE 250: Computer Architecture (Spring 2022-Spring 2024)
- Teach weekly recitation section, lead office hours, monitor student question forum, grade assignments

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Explored the Duke archives and EEBO with computational and literary research as part of an interdisciplinary project team to study discourse around premodern ethical consumerism
- Attended the NeMLA conference to present research at the undergraduate forum
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Literary Criticism · Close Reading · Collaborative Problem Solving

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
- Completed data science research within the David M. Rubenstein Library's card catalog file as part of the Duke Data+ program
- Created a structured dataset using OCR and NLP from 50,000+ images of the library’s deprecated card catalog to further their initiative of pursuing historically marginalized voices in their collections
- Performed data analysis in Python to examine the collection, including spatial heat mapping, demographical visualization, and historical exploration of Duke University; created interactive web app
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Data Science · Web Applications

projects.title: Baseball Buddy
projects.description: Built Baseball Buddy, a Python automation project that sends daily updates on the Cleveland Guardians and New York Mets through a Discord webhook. Configured GitHub Actions to run the workflow automatically, enabling reliable delivery of team news and score updates with minimal manual effort.

projects.title: Judging Books By Their Covers: Reese's Book Club and Contemporary Bookishness
projects.description:
- Cross-functional senior thesis project through the Duke English Department, receiving Highest Honors and
Most Original Thesis award.
- Created and analyzed a dataset from all books chosen for the club using Python in Jupyter Notebooks.
- Synthesized findings into a 60+ page research paper using computational and literary analysis.

organizations.name: The Trek
organizations.description: I post blogs about my backpacking adventures. You can read them here: https://thetrek.co/author/heidi-smith/

organizations.name: Rotaract Club of Duke University
organizations.description:
- I was club president for the 2022-2023 school year and served on the board for a total of three years
- Planned club meetings and events, coordinated with the Rotary Club, and served in a volunteer capacity in club events.
